evidence.quote: For 2025-12-31, holdings rows with bdc_dimensions_raw LIKE 'investmentidentifieraxis=Credit Fund |%' count 60 rows and sum to fair_value 957830000.0; for 2026-03-31, the same pattern count 70 rows and sum to 1020183000.0.

The same target quarter also has direct affiliated investment-fund positions for Middle Market Credit Fund, LLC in the Investment | Affiliated Issuer | Investment Funds section, showing the Credit Fund rows are look-through portfolio rows rather than additional direct filer positions.

rationale: Rows under the Credit Fund axis are a look-through schedule of the credit fund portfolio. They are over-included in the filer holdings alongside the filer's direct investment-fund positions and should not be summed against the filer's total investments anchor.
